events.title: Schooners Beachside Live Summer Concert Series
events.venue: Schooners Cayucos, 24 N. Ocean Ave, Cayucos
events.summary: Free outdoor beachside concerts every Sat & Sun at Schooners featuring local bands, touring artists, and house favorites through October.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.venue: Schooners Cayucos, 24 N. Ocean Ave, Cayucos
events.summary: Weekly open mic at Schooners welcomes local musicians year-round. Last-Tuesday Kam's Jams and last-Thursday Song-A-Thon also run monthly.

events.title: ECOSLO Cayucos Beach Cleanup
events.organizer: ECOSLO (Environmental Center of San Luis Obispo)
events.summary: Volunteer beach litter cleanup near the Cayucos Pier, part of California Coastal Cleanup Day. ECOSLO provides gloves, bags & supplies.

events.title: Cayucos Fall Antique Street Faire
events.venue: N. Ocean Ave (Cayucos Dr to E St), Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: 40th edition of this free outdoor antique faire with 100+ dealers selling vintage, collectibles & crafts steps from the beach. 7am–3pm, rain or shine.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.venue: N. Ocean Ave & Cayucos Dr, Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: Classic cars cruise downtown Cayucos 8am–4pm with a live band, beer garden & Lions BBQ lunch. Friday check-in party at Nelson's Garage.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting
events.summary: Free community tree lighting ceremony with Santa arriving by fire engine. Kicks off the Christmas in Cayucos weekend. 5–6:30pm.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Holiday Stroll
events.summary: Free festive holiday stroll along Ocean Ave with seasonal activities and local shops. 3–6pm, part of the annual Christmas in Cayucos celebration.
